confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and the 3-star hotel anchor is the least certain. July is rainy season in Laos, so demand is lower, but the accommodation anchors reflect typical paid rates rather than a deliberate off-season discount. The FX observation came from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA, not from a direct read of the RBA table, so it should be verified against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced relative to budget-to-mid-range Southeast Asian capitals and tourist towns such as Luang Prabang and Phnom Penh, and below Bangkok. Imported wine and cocktails are marked up from a low local base, so drink anchors are set against the local beer price.
